54 /*
55  * Register : Control Register - ctrl
56  *
57  * Contains fields that control the entire Clock Manager.
58  *
59  * Register Layout
60  *
61  * Bits | Access | Reset | Description
62  * :-------|:-------|:------|:------------------------------
63  * [0] | RW | 0x1 | Safe Mode
64  * [1] | ??? | 0x0 | *UNDEFINED*
65  * [2] | RW | 0x1 | Enable SafeMode on Warm Reset
66  * [31:3] | ??? | 0x0 | *UNDEFINED*
67  *
68  */
69 /*
70  * Field : Safe Mode - safemode
71  *
72  * When set the Clock Manager is in Safe Mode.
73  *
74  * In Safe Mode Clock Manager register settings defining clock behavior are ignored
75  * and clocks are set to a Safe Mode state.In Safe Mode all clocks with the
76  * optional exception of debug clocks, are directly generated from the EOSC1 clock
77  * input, all PLLs are bypassed, all programmable dividers are set to 1 and all
78  * clocks are enabled.
79  *
80  * This bit should only be cleared when clocks have been correctly configured
81  *
82  * This field is set on a cold reset and optionally on a warm reset and may not be
83  * set by SW.
84  *
85  * Field Access Macros:
86  *
87  */

90 /* The Most Significant Bit (MSB) position of the ALT_CLKMGR_CTL_SAFEMOD register field. */
91 #define ALT_CLKMGR_CTL_SAFEMOD_MSB 0
92 /* The width in bits of the ALT_CLKMGR_CTL_SAFEMOD register field. */
93 #define ALT_CLKMGR_CTL_SAFEMOD_WIDTH 1
94 /* The mask used to set the ALT_CLKMGR_CTL_SAFEMOD register field value. */
95 #define ALT_CLKMGR_CTL_SAFEMOD_SET_MSK 0x00000001
96 /* The mask used to clear the ALT_CLKMGR_CTL_SAFEMOD register field value. */
97 #define ALT_CLKMGR_CTL_SAFEMOD_CLR_MSK 0xfffffffe
98 /* The reset value of the ALT_CLKMGR_CTL_SAFEMOD register field. */

102 /* Produces a ALT_CLKMGR_CTL_SAFEMOD register field value suitable for setting the register. */
